jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The best coding assistants have to do two hard things together: understand code as the structured, interconnected system it really is, and keep learning from every interaction so they get better over time. Most AI tools today do neither well. They flatten code into tokens and lose the structure that makes software navigable, and they start each session from scratch, forgetting what they learned yesterday about a developer's codebase, patterns, and way of working. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is assembling an elite team of scientists and engineers to change both at once, and we are hiring an Applied Scientist who will work across code understanding and continual learning as a single, connected problem. You will help create generative AI technologies, including Kiro IDE and CLI, that are transforming how software gets built.  
  
In this role you will turn the many signals around code, from static analysis and symbol graphs to build systems and language servers, into a unified representation our models can reason over, and you will make that system learn over time, so it accumulates knowledge without forgetting what it already knew, retrieves the right memory at the right moment, and personalizes the experience for each developer and team. These are not two separate jobs. A system that understands code deeply is also the one best positioned to remember and personalize how it helps, and you will own that intersection end to end. Your work will reach millions of developers rather than sit in a paper.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Build representations of code that fuse static analysis, symbol and call graphs, type information, and build system context, and that models can use at repository scale

  

* Make those systems learn over time through memory-augmented architectures, retrieval mechanisms, and personalization that consolidate and recall knowledge across sessions

  

* Invent and implement state-of-the-art machine learning solutions that operate at unprecedented Amazon scale

  

* Deploy products that directly impact the daily workflows of millions of developers worldwide

  

* Publish and present your work at premier ML, NLP, and software engineering conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, ICSE, FSE)

Lawyers bill in six-minute increments, and every one of them counts. Litify Time & Billing turns that time into revenue: time entry, billing rules and rates, pre-bills and invoices, payments, e-billing, and a two-way sync with Accounting Seed. If you like problems where a rounding rule matters and an invoice has to be right every time, this is your team.

**About the Role**  
Litify is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Time & Billing team. The code you ship decides how firms capture their time, bill their clients, and get paid. We recently integrated with an AI time-capture partner, so the work lawyers do during the day becomes time entries that flow straight into billing. That is the kind of work this team takes on, and on a small team, your part in it is visible.

We want a strong, versatile engineer who works across the stack and is eager to dig into new technologies. Our product runs on Salesforce. Prior Salesforce experience isn't required: if you come from Java, C#, TypeScript, or a similar stack, senior engineers on the team will help you learn the platform.

We want someone who already builds this way, knows how to check what the assistant produces, works within solid guardrails, and helps teammates do the same. AI makes each of us faster, but the team still designs, reviews, and decides together.

**How we work:**  
We value speed and follow-through. If you like shipping steadily and seeing your impact in the numbers, you will fit in here.

* We are a team of four engineers, part of a team of nine with an engineering manager, a product manager, a UX designer, and two QA engineers
* We work in two-week agile sprints, where engineers and Product refine the work together and we estimate story points as a team
* We track what we complete each week and look at how AI helps us deliver more
* Features start from Figma designs and go through full QA and a package regression pass before each release
* We ship three major releases a year as Salesforce managed packages, plus patch releases, on a set schedule rather than through continuous deployment
* We keep meetings to a minimum and work through Jira and Slack

**In this role, you will:**

* Design and build features for time capture, billing, and invoicing, from the data model to the UI
* Help lead how the team builds with AI, from agent workflows and shared prompts to review practices
* Build and maintain integrations, from our Accounting Seed sync to AI time-capture partners
* Help build, test, and ship our releases
* Go beyond the code: help shape requirements with Product, test your work end to end with QA, and refine UI details with UX
* Contribute to project documentation and knowledge bases

* Solid data modeling and SQL skills, including working with large data sets and designing code that scales

* Daily, hands-on experience building software with AI coding assistants
* An ability to communicate clearly with Engineering and Product, including teammates in other time zones

* Experience building AI tooling, such as custom agents, MCP servers, or shared prompt libraries

* Help shape the team's AI practices and grow into leading them

Prior Salesforce experience isn't required: if you come from Java, C#, TypeScript, or a similar stack, senior engineers on the team will help you learn the platform.

**AI-assisted development is how this team works.** We use AI coding assistants every day to plan, write, test, and review code. We want someone who already builds this way, knows how to check what the assistant produces, works within solid guardrails, and helps teammates do the same. AI makes each of us faster, but the team still designs, reviews, and decides together.

**How we work:**  
We value speed and follow-through. If you like shipping steadily and seeing your impact in the numbers, you will fit in here.

* We are a team of four engineers, part of a team of nine with an engineering manager, a product manager, a UX designer, and two QA engineers
* We work in two-week agile sprints, where engineers and Product refine the work together and we estimate story points as a team
* We track what we complete each week and look at how AI helps us deliver more
* Features start from Figma designs and go through full QA and a package regression pass before each release
* We ship three major releases a year as Salesforce managed packages, plus patch releases, on a set schedule rather than through continuous deployment
* We keep meetings to a minimum and work through Jira and Slack

**In this role, you will:**

* Design and build features for time capture, billing, and invoicing, from the data model to the UI
* Help lead how the team builds with AI, from agent workflows and shared prompts to review practices
* Build and maintain integrations, from our Accounting Seed sync to AI time-capture partners
* Help build, test, and ship our releases
* Go beyond the code: help shape requirements with Product, test your work end to end with QA, and refine UI details with UX
* Contribute to project documentation and knowledge bases

**To be successful in this role, you have (required):**

* 4+ years of experience with a typed back-end language (for example Java, C#, TypeScript)
* Front-end experience with modern JavaScript, a component framework such as React, and CSS styling
* Solid data modeling and SQL skills, including working with large data sets and designing code that scales
* A habit of writing tests
* Daily, hands-on experience building software with AI coding assistants
* An ability to communicate clearly with Engineering and Product, including teammates in other time zones

**Nice-to-have:**

* Prior experience developing on Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL), or Salesforce Administrator or Platform Developer certifications
* Experience at a Salesforce ISV, such as releasing managed packages and passing security review
* Legal billing knowledge, such as fee arrangements, rates, write-downs, and LEDES e-billing
* Experience with Accounting Seed or another finance or ERP product
* Experience building AI tooling, such as custom agents, MCP servers, or shared prompt libraries

**Where you can grow:**

* Learn the Salesforce platform with support from senior engineers
* Use professional development funds for courses, conferences, and certifications, including Salesforce certifications
* Grow into owning an area of the product, from design through release
* Help shape the team's AI practices and grow into leading them
* Build toward a senior role at a company that likes to promote from within

**Disclosure:**

This job is fully remote, with the exception of employees living in New York City and New Jersey. Our NYC/NJ employees adhere to our hybrid schedule, which involves working in our Manhattan office 6 days a month.

The estimated base salary for this role is $115-120k. You may also be offered a bonus and benefits.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.
